description: Systematic inventory of qualified evidence sources for Commander Studio (P0 Deliverable 1).

sources.title: Scryfall Bulk Manifest & Oracle Cards
sources.observation_period: All released MTG sets through November 2026
sources.coverage_scope: 100% of all MTG cards; 801 / 801 format- and color-legal Chulane cards
sources.double_counting_risk: None; cards fold strictly 1:1 to canonical oracle_id across printings.
sources.license_terms: Scryfall API Terms: free personal / non-commercial use with fan content attribution.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Bulk GET (daily manifest, conditional ETag requests; no single-card polling loop).
bias_risks: Facts and mechanics, no evaluation of gameplay strength or deck fit
Scryfall Tagger roles are subjective community classifications and not authoritative Oracle facts
sources.status_rationale: Fully verified daily bulk dataset imported into studio.sqlite3 (scryfall_card, 35,353 cards); covers 801 / 801 legal Chulane cards.

sources.title: Playgroup.gg Card Atlas & Gameplay Research
sources.coverage_scope: Subset of cards actively cast in Playgroup Live games
sources.double_counting_risk: Pod clustering: repeated games by the same local playgroups skew frequencies; paper games tracked without digital card logging lack card events.
sources.license_terms: Aggregated statistics CC BY 4.0 with attribution; raw game events, client code and card graphics are proprietary and not licensed.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: MANUAL_INSPECTION_ONLY (No public unauthenticated bulk export; automated scraping violates ToS).
bias_risks: Observed correlations are NOT causal proof of card efficacy
Survivorship bias: drawn-to-played measures only cards drawn in surviving game states
Pilot- and pod-clustering bias
Missing long-tail coverage: cards with few live appearances remain completely unobserved
sources.status_rationale: Methodology is valuable for metric definition (cast turn, drawn-to-played); automated data extraction is blocked by lack of open bulk API. Documented as gap.

sources.title: Playgroup.gg Chulane Commander Performance
sources.observation_period: Aggregated live games through November 2026 (~2,094 recorded games)
sources.coverage_scope: Chulane cards with sufficient live appearances in Playgroup Live
sources.double_counting_risk: Repeated matches of the same deck/pilot combination in a recurring playgroup.
sources.license_terms: CC BY 4.0 for aggregated statistics; no licensed raw data feed.
bias_risks: Seat position skew: Seat 1 shows 45.3% winrate (674 games), Seat 5 shows 16.3% (43 games)
Archetype skew: Playgroup Chulane population is heavily Landfall-focused
Small sample sizes for non-staple cards (n < 30)
sources.status_rationale: Chulane winrate (36%) and card lifts are documented, but lack open bulk export and carry heavy pilot/seat confounding. Gaps must remain explicit.

sources.title: EDHREC Chulane Recommendations & Relative Lift
sources.observation_period: Two-year rolling window of online decklists (Archidekt, Moxfield)
sources.coverage_scope: Top ~1,300 cards appearing in online Chulane decks; long-tail (<1%) omitted
sources.double_counting_risk: Thematic and budget subviews overlap with the main commander page; must never be summed across cohorts.
sources.license_terms: EDHREC Public API / Web usage: Non-commercial citation; rate limiting required.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Polite GET with retry/backoff; conditional caching; respect robots.txt.
bias_risks: Popularity bias: deckbuilding presence != gameplay strength or winrate
Lift is relative deck co-occurrence, NOT winrate lift!
Echo-chamber bias: popular precons and internet lists dominate builder selections
sources.status_rationale: 20 fresh HTTP200 snapshots from 2026-11-11 are SHA-256 verified (Run #43024442970, Refs #1186). 1,304 legacy rows remain explicitly qualified with retrieved_at_utc=NULL.

sources.title: Commander Spellbook Combo Variants API
sources.coverage_scope: All known and rule-verified MTG combos matching Chulane color identity (Bant / WUG)
sources.double_counting_risk: Redundant combo variants (e.g. same loop with different bounce targets) must not be counted as independent strength claims.
sources.license_terms: MIT License (Backend) / CC BY 4.0 (Combo Dataset); completely open for free use.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: REST API GET (with commander filter); local caching; polite polling.
bias_risks: Existence of a combo is NOT proof of consistency, speed, resilience or in-game winrate
Complex 4+ piece combos are rarely executed in real games
sources.status_rationale: Fully open and licensed REST API. Adapter in src/commander_lab/commander_spellbook.py is verified and operational.

sources.title: ACTIVE-Drive Curated Chulane 99-Card Deck Corpus
sources.coverage_scope: 975 deduplicated full 99-card Chulane decks (429 observed, 372 unobserved cards in 801 pool)
sources.double_counting_risk: 19 content duplicates in the 994 registered sources resolved to 975 unique decks.
sources.license_terms: Local private project research data; strictly local under AGENTS.md §12.
bias_risks: Corpus reflects historical collection choices and specific community deck sources
Null-case trap: 372 pool cards have 0 hits, which means unobserved, never weak
sources.status_rationale: Fully imported into studio.sqlite3 (corpus_deck, corpus_deck_card) with deduplicated denominator N=975.

sources.title: cEDH Tournament Placement & Competitive Meta
sources.double_counting_risk: Same player entering sequential tournaments with minor card swaps.
sources.license_terms: Terms of service vary; no automated scraping without license agreement.
bias_risks: Extreme selection bias: cEDH optimizes for turn 2-3 wins and fast mana incompatible with casual play
Very low sample size for Chulane in current competitive tier lists
sources.status_rationale: Valuable supplementary perspective, but requires manual audit due to cEDH selection divergence and non-bulk license terms.

sources.title: XMage Engine Card Facts & Rules Support
sources.observation_period: All cards implemented in the canonical pinned XMage Rules Core (7,231 verified cards)
sources.coverage_scope: 7,231 cards implemented in pinned XMage engine; 801 / 801 legal Chulane cards have verified readiness
sources.double_counting_risk: None; card names map deterministically to engine implementations.
bias_risks: Engine implementation coverage differs from full Oracle card universe
Tactical card mechanics without external decision control fail closed
sources.status_rationale: 100% verified locally against pinned engine rules. All 801 legal Chulane pool cards are qualified with sim_status=OK.

sources.title: Scryfall Tagger Functional Roles & Community Tags
sources.schema_format: Web / Community Tagging (CSV export when available)
sources.coverage_scope: Community functional tags: ramp, draw, removal, bounce, tutor, combo-piece
sources.double_counting_risk: Multiple overlapping tags for the same functional role (e.g. bounce-creature and bounce-permanent).
sources.license_terms: Public Community Fan Content Policy; non-commercial citation only.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: MANUAL_INSPECTION_ONLY (or authorized Scryfall bulk tags export).
bias_risks: Community tags are subjective, non-authoritative annotations, not official MTG Oracle mechanics
Inconsistent granularity across card types
sources.status_rationale: Valuable semantic role mappings imported into card_role, but requires external audit due to community subjectivity.
